en.title: A jaw that belongs to nobody

sentences.text: This lower jaw is not from any one person.
It comes from six CT scans that people shared openly, with names removed.
A computer found the jaw and teeth in each scan.
The jaws were lined up, and we kept the shape that at least half of them share.
So it is smoother than a real jaw, and some teeth are thin.
Use it as a typical jaw to compare with the other models.
